text:
nina_marketing: Quick check-in: we need a pared-down SEO checklist for the upcoming launch post + webinar replay page. Core asks: keywords, JSON-LD, canonical strategy, redirect CSV for legacy URLs, and an internal linking map. Can someone take lead? Sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/EXAMPLE

 devin_seo: I'll lead. Deliverables: keyword matrix (head + longtail), JSON-LD for Event + VideoObject (if hosted), canonical decisions, and redirect CSV with source,target,code,notes. Will populate sheet by EOD.

 leah_content: I'll map H1/H2 and meta descriptions, plus anchor text suggestions for internal linking. Also audit existing posts for overlap and flag merges.

 maya_growth: Growth note: add utm params for registration and replay CTAs. Suggested utm_campaign=serve_llm_launch_q2. Also ensure partner vanity paths are redirected with utm preserved.

 owen_ops: Eng can ingest CSV into CDN edge redirects. For query string-preserve add a flag column. If partner rewrites needed, we can add nginx rules in the config repo; send examples.

 devin_seo: JSON-LD snippet I'll paste in sheet. Quick canonical policy: landing canonical -> /webinars/serve-llm; replay canonical -> /blog/serve-llm-replay. Mark query params as noindex. Update sitemap after pushes.

 nina_marketing: small ask: can we include FAQ schema on the replay post to boost SERP real estate?

 devin_seo: yes, add FAQPage mainEntity. Also include breadcrumbList to help sitelinks.

 seo-scan-bot: scheduled crawl at 1834720250 reported 1 broken image and 0 redirect loops on staging. See DM for details.

 nina_marketing: thanks all. timeline: keywords + JSON-LD today, redirect CSV tomorrow morning, eng ingestion Monday. tagging @owen_ops when CSV ready.
